title: A blocked task that keeps repeating is backed off, not re-prompted every turn
behavior: The model makes no progress: the same next todo, no commit, every turn. With the shipped debounce (30 s) and a 9 s turn, an unbraked loop re-prompts every 39 s, as in the incident where lanes were re-prompted 988, 690 and 488 times. The brake must bound the re-prompts without disarming the loop.

messages.text:
# Loop Start Command
Work the session todo list one ticket at a time.

todos.content: C1 #1773 make the upload test pass

expected: Over two simulated hours: about 8 continuations (an unbraked loop would send about 184, one per 39 s). Stalls 2-4 wait 5 minutes, stalls 5+ wait 30 minutes. The loop never disarms and still continues in the second hour.
